prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: premium landscape PXA app-store promotional cover, 16:9, approximately 1536x864, opaque background.
App title exact text: "随译翻译".
Primary request: create original polished cover art for a compact multilingual text and voice translation app. Its actual identity uses warm off-white, deep ink teal #203b38 and mint green #178577. The theme is clear communication between languages.
Subject: two beautifully crafted floating conversation tiles, one displaying the single Chinese character "文", the other the single Latin letter "A", connected by a pair of elegant curved exchange arrows. A small tasteful microphone and soft audio waveform suggest voice input and spoken translations. These are sculptural promotional symbols, not app interface controls.
Style: refined editorial 3D illustration, softly rounded ceramic and frosted glass forms, crisp edges, restrained depth, subtle mint gradients, gentle shadows, excellent light and visual hierarchy.
Composition: bold title on the left with generous safe margins, hero language tiles and audio motif in the center-right; calm negative space, readable at thumbnail sizes. Match the understated mint/cream palette of the app.
Text: only "随译翻译", "文", and "A". Render the Chinese title exactly and prominently, with balanced clear typography.
Constraints: no screenshots, fake UI, menus, ratings, badges, system bars, navigation indicators, device mockups, watermarks or third-party brand logos. No claims of free voice service, offline operation, camera translation or extra features. No additional words.
